title: Task 4: Final SRD epic verification
description: Objective: Verify the SRD epic acceptance criteria end to end and close the epic only if all child tasks are complete. Files: no production files expected unless verification exposes a defect. Steps: 1. Run npm run build. 2. Run npm run test. 3. Run bd show loreweaver-zzy and confirm all acceptance criteria are covered by closed children. 4. Record verification evidence on loreweaver-zzy. 5. Close loreweaver-zzy only after all children are closed and verification is green.
design: This is a verification and cleanup task. If a defect is found, create or reopen a targeted child issue rather than expanding this task.
acceptance_criteria: Build passes; tests pass; loreweaver-zzy acceptance criteria are satisfied; no untracked generated files remain except intentional build artifacts ignored by git.
close_reason: Final SRD verification passed: npm run build exit 0 and npm run test exit 0 with 25 passed / 1 skipped; epic acceptance checked.
